data.arguments: {"summary": "Fixed Cache.__setitem__ capacity accounting in cachetools/__init__.py: when replacing an existing key, eviction now only needs to accommodate the size difference (new size minus old size) instead of the full new size, so unrelated entries are no longer evicted when the replacement fits. If eviction removes the key being replaced, the accounting switches to the full new size since the old size is no longer counted. New insertions, equal-size replacements, shrinking values, and oversized-value errors keep their previous behavior, and currsize stays equal to the summed item sizes. Also added __getstate__/__setstate__ so the new internal counter is not pickled (keeps existing pickling behavior)."}
